production_notes: Exports: five 1080 x 1350 carousel frames plus an 8-second 1080 x 1920 motion slideshow.
Keep the warm neutral grade consistent and typography minimal.
Use the silent master for platform-native music; the procedural score is a reusable fallback.
Curated Pexels material must not be described as personally filmed or photographed.
Human visual and audio approval is required before scheduling.

instagram.caption: Coffee, window light, and nowhere urgent to be. A small luxury that does not need a reservation.
instagram.cta: Coffee alone or coffee with good company?
instagram.music_search: In Instagram or Edits, search for warm acoustic ambience or soft morning piano; add it after upload.
instagram.music_reuse_policy: Reuse on Facebook only if Meta confirms the selected track is cleared for both placements.
instagram.schedule_notes: Primary format: five-image 4:5 carousel. Optional Reel: use the clean 8-second motion slideshow.

facebook.caption: Coffee, window light, and nowhere urgent to be. Some mornings feel luxurious simply because they are allowed to unfold slowly. Coffee alone or with company?
facebook.cta: Tell me what your ideal slow morning looks like.
facebook.music_search: For the slideshow Reel, use the same Meta-cleared track as Instagram or keep the original procedural score.
facebook.music_reuse_policy: Confirm Facebook clearance inside Meta before reusing Instagram music.
facebook.schedule_notes: Publish the five-photo post or slideshow Reel; do not publish both at the same time.

tiktok.caption: A slow morning feels expensive even when all it costs is coffee.
tiktok.cta: Photo mode or quiet slideshow - which fits this mood better?
tiktok.music_search: Choose a current soft morning, cafe jazz, or acoustic sound inside TikTok; use the Commercial Music Library when required.
tiktok.music_reuse_policy: Keep TikTok-library music on TikTok; use the clean or procedural-audio master elsewhere.
tiktok.schedule_notes: Prefer TikTok Photo Mode with the five carousel frames; the 8-second slideshow is the fallback.

youtube_shorts.title: SLOW MORNING | Coffee, light, no rush
youtube_shorts.caption: Coffee, window light, and nowhere urgent to be. A small visual pause for an unhurried morning.
youtube_shorts.cta: Coffee alone or with good company?
youtube_shorts.music_search: Use the original procedural score or choose a soft instrumental inside the Shorts audio library.
youtube_shorts.music_reuse_policy: Do not reuse a Shorts-library track outside YouTube without separate permission.
youtube_shorts.schedule_notes: Upload the clean 8-second vertical slideshow and use a distinct title.

threads.caption: A slow morning feels expensive even when all it costs is coffee. Coffee alone, or coffee with someone who understands silence?
threads.music_search: Use one carousel still; no music is necessary.
threads.music_reuse_policy: Do not carry licensed platform music into Threads.
threads.schedule_notes: Text-led post; attach carousel frame 2 or 4 only if it strengthens the post.

x.caption: A slow morning feels expensive even when all it costs is coffee.
x.music_search: Use one still or the procedural-audio master; music is optional.
x.music_reuse_policy: Do not reuse licensed TikTok, Meta, or Shorts music on X.
x.schedule_notes: Attach the strongest still or the clean 8-second slideshow; keep the post concise.

stories.timing: Publish after the main Instagram carousel; reuse on Facebook Stories if desired.

checklist: Open the five carousel JPGs, slideshow masters, cover, and contact sheet.
Confirm all five carousel frames are 1080 x 1350 and visually coherent.
Confirm source pages, creators, license evidence, and SHA-256 hashes in manifest.json.
Confirm the video master is 1080 x 1920, H.264, 8 seconds, and watermark-free.
Choose either carousel or Reel as the primary Meta post; do not duplicate both immediately.
Add platform music natively and record the actual track in this file.
Verify caption, CTA, hashtags, cover, date, time zone, and preview before scheduling.
